comparison.objective: Screen media from finished parts vs close a telescoping-lid product box.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load sharing and particle bridge release vs level, square, close-clearance lid alignment without wedging.
comparison.success_condition: Recovery/retention with no spill and released support dwell vs lid fully seated, centred, square, product enclosed, box still and released.
comparison.reason: Both require careful placement, but only the candidate tests granular flow through real apertures.
